about_the_game:
Yami kids is a retro, monster taming game that revolves around the Yami Kids, and their role in both the Overworld, and The Underworld.

Uncover the mystery on why an evil organization is making every effort to track down the Yami family, and put an end to the Yami lineage

Let's Meet the Protagonists!

Enjoy playing as Yuki and Yumi Yami, famously known as "The Yami twins"!

Yuki Yami

A dependable older brother (by about 5 minutes) who's got a tongue as sharp as his dagger eyes. Yuki will do anything to protect his "little" sister, even if that means delving into the underworld and back!

Yumi Yami

The adorable younger sister that has an unusual obsession with fire and creepy things. Though cute on the outside, Yumi has a wacky personality that's reflective of the Twins harsh upbringing in The Slums.

Core Game

Yami Kids features retro graphics with modern-day Quality of Life, various difficulty settings, gameplay customizations, and a brand new twist on a classic genre.

The Battle System

Yami Kids has a monster vs monster setup, as well as 2v2 battles. Navigate your way through a fun new twist on turn-based battles, with 80+ Oni to train and collect.

Introducing the Monsters

Yami Kids is filled with Powerful "Oni", which you can summon, collect, train, and do with what you wish! Just be sure not to get on their bad side...

What makes Yami Kids unique?

One key part of Yami Kids are "Shadow Duels" that only take place at night. This is where you battle with real monsters, rather than simulated ones. Due to the dangers that revolve around the monsters in this world, the loss of a shadow duel results in the death of the losing party.

When the player loses a battle, they get sent to the Underworld, a place where you can get unique items, visit mysterious places, and perform various activities before making a deal with the "residents" there to get sent back home to the world of the living.

Other Key features may include:

  • Built-in Nuzlocke System (Monsters die for good upon death)

  • Hardcore modes (increased difficulty, super-hardmode resulting in save deletion, etc)

  • The "Tower of Yami" where players can test their skills

  • 2 "Game Versions" chosen at save file creation for gameplay variety

  • Local Trading of Monsters and items (between save files)

content_descriptors.notes: The story begins with the death of a loved one, and how they cope with it. Two young adults are later killed in an act of violence, and end up in the underworld. The story revolves around rebirth and revenge against their killer.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 10th Gen Quad core processor or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 760 (or equivalent) and up
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.
